project_type: Sentinel EDR - Windows userland EDR. C# solution with Sentinel.Core (library), Sentinel.Service (SYSTEM Windows service host), Sentinel.Agent (user-session WinForms tray host), and tests/Sentinel.Tests (xUnit).
build_system: dotnet / MSBuild via Sentinel.sln. All product projects target net48-windows.
test_framework: xUnit (tests/Sentinel.Tests). Tests must NOT require elevation, network, or specific filesystem state.
verification_instructions: Run the build command (must compile clean), then the test command (all tests, including new ones, must pass). Do NOT bump version.txt; do NOT run installer/release.ps1 or push.ps1. Use temp directories only in tests.
environment_constraints: Worktree root is e:\Gorstak\Sentinel\.worktrees\aggressive-dll-sweep on branch feature/aggressive-dll-sweep (off main). Relative paths resolve to the PARENT repo - always use absolute worktree paths. Commit locally; never push. Do not touch version.txt.
contribution_requirements: AGENTS.md + docs/constraints.md hard rules: NO shelling out to system tools for detection/response (in-process .NET only); NO persistence/scheduled tasks/self-replication; Dependency Injection everywhere (no 'new' for injected services); thread CancellationToken through all async methods; no static mutable state (use ConcurrentDictionary); no string-built JSON; every catch logs (Debug minimum); Tier2 detections NEVER trigger a response (LogOnly unconditionally); compiled config only (feature flags are properties on SentinelConfig with compiled defaults - disk JSON does not enable them); monitors registered via MonitorGroup (no flat AddHostedService); each monitor lives in its group file (no monolith files); adversarial mindset (a filename/path alone never self-authorizes). The user explicitly APPROVED an opt-in aggressive unsigned-DLL sweep as a deliberate non-default mode gated behind a flag defaulting FALSE.
key_patterns: Monitors modeled on LnkUncGuard (PsPortedMonitors.cs): ctor-inject DetectionEngine + QuarantineManager + ILogger<T>; ExecuteAsync with settle delay then periodic internal ScanAllAsync(CancellationToken); ConcurrentDictionary alert-cooldown; emit via _detectionEngine.EmitAsync(new DetectionEvent{...}). Rules modeled on UnsignedBinaryRule (Rules.PathProvenance.cs): Name property, [RuleCategory(DetectionCategory.X)] attribute, DetectionEvent? Evaluate(FusedTelemetryContext context) that casts context.TriggeringEvent to ProcessTelemetry. QuarantineManager.QuarantineFileAtomicAsync(path, forceQuarantineSigned: true) returns the vault path or null; it STILL refuses SecurityValidation.IsOsCriticalPath(path) internally even when forced (safety net). SecurityValidation.VerifyAuthenticodeSignature(path) returns true only for a valid chained signature. ModuleIdentity.IsOsServicingPath(path) and ModuleIdentity.IsKeepTree(path) are static guards. HoneypotDllMonitor.HoneypotSubdir names the honeypot folder.
